title: Random migration (/api/random -> NDJSON)

implementation.seeded: SQLite ORDER BY rowid LIMIT ? OFFSET ? semantics: walk rowid order (recent.json ids), count matcher hits, compute offset = |seed| % max(1, total - limit), slice the window — deterministic and seed-stable (parity-verified)
implementation.unseeded: SQLite RANDOM() parity — uniform reservoir sampling over the candidate walk (limit n reservoir, random j swaps)
implementation.fetch: fetchRows on the picked ids (Set-filtered streaming for uncached subject parts)

verification.parity: random seeded, random seeded filters, random unseeded: PASS
verification.bench: random_seeded 904ms cold vs 0.2ms sqlite (rowid-order walk needs both ids array + meta; warm path ~same once loaded)

memory_note: walk is O(total) per request over the ids array (44MB resident); no heap spikes (rows materialized only for picked ids)
